policy: Render real benchmark values only when the row has a source URL, source date, and visible caveat. Otherwise render the benchmark as tracked or queued, not scored.

benchmarks.label: METR Time Horizon
benchmarks.display_rule: Plot p50 and p80 human-expert minutes on a log scale. Do not project trend lines.
benchmarks.caveat: METR excludes central estimates above 16 hours from its doubling-time fit.

benchmarks.label: Epoch AI model database
benchmarks.display_rule: Use for compute, cost, parameter, and release trend charts once the renderer pulls the CSV snapshot.

benchmarks.label: LMArena leaderboard
benchmarks.display_rule: Use current leaderboard state for frontier/open gap; label as rolling-state, not news.

benchmarks.label: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.display_rule: Render only after exact row, model, score, and date are captured.

benchmarks.label: SWE-bench
benchmarks.display_rule: Render verified/pro rows separately; do not merge suites without a formula.

benchmarks.label: FrontierMath
benchmarks.display_rule: Render only when public result rows include model, score, and date.

benchmarks.label: Robotics endurance
benchmarks.display_rule: Track hours, intervention counts, recovery behavior, and task diversity only when directly visible or reported.
